symptom: Dependabot Updates failed twice on main (security_update_not_possible)
cause: New node-forge advisories needed 1.4.3, but the overrides in the two Newman packages pinned 1.4.2
fix: Raised the override to 1.4.3 in both packages and regenerated the lockfiles
checkDoes: Overrides must agree across packages and match every lockfile copy

symptom: Every browser job failed at the Playwright install, twice, while the runners could not resolve archive.ubuntu.com
cause: The install used apt on all three tries, so a mirror outage failed all three
fix: The last try skips apt and installs the browser only, with a warning
checkDoes: Pins the shape: the last of three tries skips apt, the first two keep it, a failed last try still exits 1

symptom: The dashboard counted a job as flaky when its dependency audit failed on a commit that had passed the day before
cause: A newly published advisory fails the audit with no code change, so the job is not unstable
fix: A job whose only failed step is the dependency audit is no longer counted as flaky (it still counts in the pass rate)
checkDoes: An audit-only failure is not a flaky job

symptom: A Dependabot group pull request failed seven jobs at npm ci (ERESOLVE)
cause: The group moved the OpenTelemetry exporters and api to versions that need core 3, but left sdk-trace-node on 2.x, which needs api below 1.10
fix: The OpenTelemetry packages are their own group, and the api and exporter versions are held back until sdk-trace-node 3 is published
checkDoes: Keeps the group and keeps the hold-back while sdk-trace-node is on 2.x; each fails when its setting is removed

symptom: A banking-api-ui Cypress test failed now and then (second.response is undefined)
cause: Cypress lists a call in @alias.all when it is sent and adds the reply later, so a reply read straight after was missing
fix: Read the reply inside a retrying should
checkDoes: Fails when a spec reads a reply from @alias.all outside should

symptom: CI recheck failed with exit 127, and a Monitor push failed with HTTP 500
cause: The recheck job had no checkout, so scripts/retry.sh did not exist; the push was not retried
fix: Checked out the repo in the recheck job and retried the Monitor push
checkDoes: A job that runs a repo script must check the repo out first

symptom: The ci-health issue stayed open after main went green
cause: CI recheck judged a confirmed failure by its latest run, and nothing re-runs CI recheck once CI is green again
fix: A failed CI recheck becomes resolved once every other workflow is free of problems; while anything else is a problem it stays failing
checkDoes: Five tests: settles when everything else is green, stays failing for each problem state, leaves real failures alone, wired into the main flow

symptom: A CI job failed pulling a Docker image (run 40954762292)
cause: Docker Hub answered 502 or 504 now and then
fix: Image pulls go through scripts/retry.sh: 3 tries, 10 s then 20 s apart
checkDoes: Retries up to 3 times and fails if all 3 fail

symptom: multi-user-flow-patterns failed on the first attempt (expected 6 items, got 0) and passed on the retry
cause: The test read locator.count() as soon as the URL changed; count() does not wait and the slow user's list was not drawn yet
checkDoes: The Playwright lint rejects a bare locator.count() in a spec
